key_insight: An attention graph neural network can be trained without labels by minimizing finite-volume residuals directly on the mesh to predict coupled thermo-fluid fields.
engineering_relevance: This removes the need to generate large CFD training datasets, reducing both simulation cost and storage while preserving accurate physics-aware surrogate predictions.
method: Build an attention GNN on the computational mesh
Use finite-volume residuals of the governing equations as the loss
Train and evaluate against CFD references in steady and transient thermo-fluid cases
evidence_signal: Across four test scenarios, the FVM-loss model achieved 2.3–2.8% all-field nRMSE on steady cases and outperformed a supervised baseline on transient cases.
watch_item: Performance depends on accurate residual evaluation on the mesh, so stability and generalization may be sensitive to mesh quality, boundary conditions, and solver formulation.
paper_title: Label-Free Finite-Volume-Residual Training of Attention Graph Neural Networks for Coupled Thermo-Fluid Fields
